_comment: The COMPLETE list of surfaces allowed to run with minUnlockTier 'any_authenticated' — usable by a signed-in member who has NOT been approved in Unlock. Unlock approval is what grants access to this app: every other surface requires it, and a new one should use the 'approved_full' default. Enforced by ctf/scripts/check-unlock-tier-exceptions.mjs; CI fails on any call site missing here, and on any entry that has stopped using the bypass, so the list can only shrink on its own. kind 'machinery' = the Unlock gate cannot function if this is gated (the flow itself, the account area, bug reporting, small feeds a gated screen needs to render). kind 'exception' = a real capability deliberately opened to unapproved members by a dated owner decision, and every one needs 'feature' and 'decision'. There are exactly three such features, named below. ADDING A FOURTH IS THE OWNER'S DECISION, NEVER A BUILD STEP — ask first; the answer for a new surface is almost always 'approved_full'.

exceptions.reason: The Unlock flow itself. A member with no tier yet has to be able to reach the thing that grants one.
Unlock submission and status routes — same reason as the page above.
Your own account screen. Nobody may be locked out of seeing or deleting their own data by a tier.
Your own block list; same posture as the rest of the account area.
Your own data export and deletion screen.
Account, profile, and deletion routes behind the account area.
Your own Chyme profile record, reachable from the account area.
Your own SkillsHunt profile record, reachable from the account area.
Filing a problem report. The member most likely to hit a bug is the one stuck in onboarding, and gating this would silence exactly them.
The one-time notice state for a screen a not-yet-approved member can already see.
The currency options feed for a dropdown on a gated screen. Reads a global catalog, not anyone's data.

Knowledge library contribution (owner decision, 2026-07-29). Contributing is a route INTO verification: judging a contribution means looking at a real person writing real things, which is the same look Unlock asks for.
The routes behind the knowledge library contribution above.
Contributions is open to any signed-in member; a fundraiser nobody may reach raises nothing.
The routes behind the Contributions screen above.

Quora account deletion survey (owner decision, 2026-08-19). The research is about people outside this app, so approval cannot be the bar without sampling only the members already reached; sign-in keeps bulk junk out and is not a claim that the member is verified.
The submit route behind the survey above.
